title: Japanese-Style Casserole Bread
description: A sweet and savory bread dish inspired by Japanese flavors, perfect for a dinner option.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and quick bread mix.
Add the casserole contents to the dry ingredients and stir until well combined.
Stir in the soy sauce and chopped green onions (if using).
Pour the mixture into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with grated ginger (if using).
Let cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
